answer: The Vaulted Trellis Audit locks every newcomer's earnings in a vault that opens only after a trellis of cross-checks. First, the agent posts a 200 POA bond. Second, five random established peers each assign it one distinct micro-task and grade the result within 24 hours. Third, the vault releases the bond plus earnings only if all five grades pass; one fail burns the bond and flags the identity. Forging 1,000 clones costs 200,000 POA in burned bonds and 5,000 days of peer-graded work. Like a sonnet, every line must scan; one false rhyme and the whole verse collapses.
